description: This file declares functions and utilities for performing matrix multiplication (matmul) using MKL-DNN (oneDNN) optimized routines within PyTorch's ATen library. It includes function prototypes for different data types, checking utility functions, and external dependencies related to tensor operations and configurations.

methods.name: mkldnn_matmul
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication using MKL-DNN with optional scaling factors.

methods.name: use_mkldnn_bf16_matmul
methods.description: Checks whether BF16 MKL-DNN matmul should be used.

methods.name: use_mkldnn_fp16_matmul
methods.description: Checks whether FP16 MKL-DNN matmul should be used.

methods.name: use_mkldnn_bf32_matmul
methods.description: Checks whether BF32 MKL-DNN matmul should be used.

methods.name: use_mkldnn_tf32_matmul
methods.description: Checks whether TF32 MKL-DNN matmul should be used.

methods.name: mkldnn_bf16_gemm
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN optimized GEMM for BF16 data type.

methods.name: mkldnn_bf16f32_gemm
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN GEMM converting BF16 inputs to FP32 for computation.

methods.name: mkldnn_fp16_gemm
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN GEMM for FP16 data type.

methods.name: mkldnn_reduced_f32_gemm
methods.description: Performs reduced precision GEMM with implicit data type reduction from FP32.

methods.name: use_mkldnn_matmul
methods.description: Checks whether to use MKLDNN optimized matmul for given tensors.

methods.name: mkldnn_matmul_i8i8i32
methods.description: Performs int8 multiplied by int8 resulting in int32 matrix multiplication.
